Hi! Im Nicole. I’m a homeschooling stay- at -home mom with passion for crafting, creating, and discovering new ways to make life creative, fun and organized on a budget. Are you interested in creative pre-k and early elementary homeschooling ideas, living a fulfilling and frugal life, learning tips and tricks to keep your home clean and organized, vegetarian cooking and meal planning, home decor and DIY projects on a budget?….then come along! Full time motherhood has its ups and downs, but its been an amazing ride. Join me on my journey to inspire moms to tap into the “super-powers” of motherhood.
